# Phase 4 findings (generated by `phase_4/make_summary.py`)

All numbers below are regenerated from the files in this directory; do not edit by hand.
Every diagnostic is evaluated on held-out validation examples of the key single-song material (Nuvole Bianche with carved gaps), gap lengths 1-4 frames, 8 examples per (activity band, gap length).
